text: 北京时间11月9日晚，美股三大股指盘初集体上涨，半导体板块、大型科技股多数反弹。美股芯片巨头超威半导体连续两个交易日大幅反弹，累计涨幅接近20%。对于美股后市，业内机构研判，伴随着短期流动性压力快速出清以及市场对政治风险逐步理性定价，短期有望阶段性企稳。考虑到美国中期选举后，市场对美伊冲突升级的预期有所降温，油价进一步大幅上涨的空间受限，因此美联储12月或再度加息，但之后将转为观望状态。(中国证券报)
text_en: On the evening of November 9 Beijing time, the three major US stock indices rose collectively at the open, with the semiconductor sector and most large-cap tech stocks rebounding. US chip giant Advanced Micro Devices rebounded sharply for two consecutive trading days, with a cumulative gain of nearly 20%. Regarding the outlook for US stocks, industry institutions believe that with the rapid clearing of short-term liquidity pressure and the market's gradual rational pricing of political risks, a phased stabilization is expected in the short term. Considering that after the US midterm elections, market expectations for an escalation of the US-Iran conflict have cooled, limiting room for further sharp oil price increases, the Federal Reserve may raise rates again in December but will then shift to a wait-and-see stance. (China Securities Journal)
